> Sieve $[N]$ by removing half the residue classes mod $p_i$, for primes $2 \leqslant p_1 < p_2 < \dots < p_{1000} < N^{9/10}$. Does the remaining set have size at most $\frac{1}{10} N$? We interpret "half the residue classes" as $\lfloor p_i / 2 \rfloor$.
